info.title: Architecture Docs API
info.description: Shared architecture documentation. The deployer chooses the organization name; all lab business data is synthetic. Read the system inventory and published architecture documents, find documentation gaps, validate drafts against the documentation standard and submit proposals for librarian review. Agents never publish directly.

tags.name: inventory
tags.description: Systems, interfaces and data products (source of truth).

tags.name: governance
tags.description: Documentation standard, validation and gap analysis.

tags.name: librarian
tags.description: Restricted publishing operation (not an agent tool).

Returns metadata of the documents in the shared store (doc_id, title, system_id, owner_team, status, version, last_reviewed, classification), without the markdown. Use it to find which document covers a system, then call getDocument for the full text.

get.description: Compares the published documents with the inventory and the documentation standard. Returns one item per gap with gap_type (missing_document, stale_review, decommissioned_system_documented, interface_missing_in_doc, decommissioned_interface_in_doc, owner_mismatch, template_noncompliance), system_id, doc_id, severity (high, medium, low), interface_id when relevant, and detail. Omit system_id to check all systems.

parameters.name: system_id
parameters.description: Check only this system, format SYS-NNN.

200.description: Documentation gaps; empty when everything is up to date.

get.summary: Get the documentation standard and document template
get.description: Returns the documentation standard and the architecture document template as markdown, plus the required front-matter fields and the required H2 sections in order. Read it before drafting or fixing a document.

401.description: Missing or invalid Entra bearer token.

post.summary: Validate a document against the standard (stores nothing)
post.description: Checks a markdown document against the documentation standard and the inventory: front matter, required sections and order, Mermaid diagram in Context, Interfaces table with INT-NNN IDs, missing active interfaces, decommissioned or unknown interfaces, owner team and credentials. Returns valid, errors, warnings and the parsed metadata. Call it before submitProposal and fix every error.

401.description: Missing or invalid Entra bearer token.

422.description: The request body is invalid, e.g. markdown is missing.

post.summary: Submit a document proposal for librarian review
post.description: Stores a new or updated architecture document as a proposal; it never publishes. The document is validated: valid becomes pending-review, invalid is stored as needs-changes with the errors. Documents containing credentials are rejected with 422 and not stored. Returns proposal_id (P-<yyyymmddHHMMSS>-<team>-<4 hex>), status, validation and stored_at. Call validateDocument first.

200.description: Proposal stored with status pending-review (valid) or needs-changes (invalid).

400.description: Bad request, e.g. invalid team or author_type.

401.description: Missing or invalid Entra bearer token.

422.description: Rejected and not stored: the document contains credential-like text (detail + findings), or the request body is invalid.

get.description: Returns proposals, newest first, with proposal_id, team, system_id, doc_id, summary, author_type, source, status (pending-review, needs-changes, published), created_at and valid. Check it before submitting to avoid duplicates.

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: Only proposals from this team, e.g. team1.

400.description: Bad request, e.g. an invalid team name.

401.description: Missing or invalid Entra bearer token.

422.description: A parameter does not match its format, e.g. system_id is not SYS-NNN.

get.description: Returns the full proposal record: team, system_id, doc_id, summary, author_type, source, status, created_at, the validation result (errors, warnings) and the submitted markdown.

parameters.description: Proposal ID returned by submitProposal, format P-<yyyymmddHHMMSS>-<team>-<4 hex>, e.g. P-20261103101500-team1-a1b2.

401.description: Missing or invalid Entra bearer token.

422.description: A parameter does not match its format, e.g. system_id is not SYS-NNN.

post.description: Librarian-only governance operation; never expose it as an agent tool. Publishes a pending-review proposal: archives the current version to archive/<doc_id>/<version>.md, writes published/<doc_id>.md and marks the proposal published. Requires header X-Publisher-Role: librarian (overwritten by the API gateway from the signed Entra Librarian role), otherwise 403. The gateway also overwrites X-Reviewer with the signed caller identity. Stale document updates return 409.

parameters.name: proposal_id
parameters.description: Proposal ID to publish, format P-<yyyymmddHHMMSS>-<team>-<4 hex>.

400.description: The proposal is not pending-review or has no doc_id.

401.description: Missing or invalid Entra bearer token.

403.description: The caller does not have the librarian role.

409.description: The published document changed after this proposal was created; review and submit an updated proposal.

422.description: A parameter does not match its format, e.g. system_id is not SYS-NNN.

EntraBearer.description: Entra token for the gateway application audience in the exported team configuration. Signed team and librarian roles are enforced by APIM.

reference_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD used for review-age checks; null = today.

status.description: draft, published or archived (from the front matter).
draft, published or archived (from the front matter).

sections.description: H2 section titles in document order.

markdown.description: Full document markdown including front matter.

via.description: System ID of the integration route, e.g. SYS-010 Integration Platform.

interfaces.description: All interfaces where the system is source, target or via.

expected_interface_ids.description: Active interfaces the system's document must list.

required_sections.description: H2 sections in the required order.

errors.description: Must be fixed before the document can be published.

warnings.description: Should be fixed; do not block publishing.

archived_previous.description: True if a previous version was archived.

markdown.description: Complete document markdown, starting with the YAML front matter block (--- ... ---).

system_id.description: System the document describes, format SYS-NNN (e.g. SYS-011). Must exist in the inventory and match system_id in the front matter.

doc_id.description: Document ID, format ARCH-XXX (2-6 capital letters). Optional: taken from the front matter when omitted. Reuse the existing doc_id to update a published document.

markdown.description: Complete document markdown with YAML front matter, following the template from getDocumentationStandard. Never include credentials.

summary.description: One or two sentences for the librarian: what changed and why.

author_type.description: Who produced the draft: agent (Foundry agent), coding-agent (e.g. a GitHub Copilot skill) or human.

source.description: Agent, tool or skill that produced the draft, e.g. docs-steward-team1.

team.description: Submitting team. Ignored behind the API gateway, which sets the team from your subscription. Defaults to local.
